        "Other": {"x": "replaced", "y": "replaced", "z": "${key}",
                  "missing_dollar": "cost $5 and $x and ${unclosed"},
    }, "ini basic")
    # order
    eq(list(got), ["", "Sec", "Other"], "ini order")
    eq(list(got["Sec"]), ["key", "other", "url"], "ini key order")

    # recursive interpolation
    got = ini.parse("[s]\na = ${b}\nb = ${c}\nc = value")
    eq(got["s"], {"a": "value", "b": "value", "c": "value"}, "ini recursive")

    # cross-section, case sensitive section, key lowercase
    got = ini.parse("[S]\nA = ${T:b}\n[T]\nB = ${c}\nC = ok")

    got = ini.parse("[s]\na = $${b}\nb = nope")
    eq(got["s"]["a"], "${b}", "ini $$")

    # indented section when not continuing
    got = ini.parse("  [s]  \n  key = v")
    eq(got, {"s": {"key": "v"}}, "ini indented section/key")

    # blank/comment breaks continuation
    got = ini.parse("[s]\nk = a\n\n  b\n# c\n  d")

    # so this is an error case; skip
